title: Real word currents and native source steps
purpose: Calculate polynomial, rational and divisor current signatures in the original arithmetic quotient; prove constant inertia along actual adjacent-source additions, observed sign dimensions, the complete signed product and the endpoint/trace/collision receiver for a prescribed current.

validation.status: Complete proofs, mathematical checks and visual inspection
validation.scope: Original analytic proofs plus 1119 exact auxiliary checks, 13 negative controls and 6 independent full-Gram fixtures. The 125-step outward integer certificate and 12 noninterval evolution diagnostics have separate scopes. No native zero or period is inferred from fixtures.
